messages:
Maria Chen: Quick idea for smoother quant rollout: define operator-hierarchy profiles (group-level defaults + per-op overrides). e.g., group 'attn' prefer int8, but 'attn-proj' can be fp8. This reduces profile surface area and makes audits easier.
Arjun Venkataraman: sounds useful. How would runtime pick between group and op? precedence rules?
Maria Chen: precedence: explicit op override > group default > model default. Keep it deterministic and cheap.
Priya Desai: how do we avoid surprising quality cliffs when combining different groups? interactions between groups might be non-linear.
Maria Chen: calibration anchors. we pick a small set of anchor prompts that exercise cross-group interactions and run differential eval when changing any group default.
Arjun Venkataraman: runtime note: don't want per-token map lookups. plan: on model load, expand profile into a compact per-op table and encode bitflags per-op so hot path is one array index. cheap.
Priya Desai: nice. Also propose group-level max_deg = 0.5% and op-level stricter max_deg = 0.2% on eval corpus. block if exceeded.
Maria Chen: agree. Also add a safety surface: any operator marked "safety_critical" can't be < int8 without manual sign-off.
Arjun Venkataraman: telemetry: emit aggregated group counters (requests, fallbacks, deg_estimate) every minute + sampled traces (0.5%) for deep diffs. we should avoid per-op histogram explosion.
Priya Desai: sampling rate probably needs to be higher for small customers. suggest per-customer override in profile meta.
Maria Chen: good point. profile meta: sampling_override: {tenant: high|low}. ops can flip for canaries.
Priya Desai: what's the on-disk/profile DSL look like?
Maria Chen: sketch:
```
model: "gptx-14b"
default: { prefer: int8, fallback: [fp8,4bit] }
groups: [
  { id: "attn", prefer: int8, max_deg_pct: 0.5 },
  { id: "ffn", prefer: fp8, fallback: [int8,4bit], max_deg_pct: 0.3 }
]
overrides: [
  { op: "attn.proj", prefer: fp8, safety_critical: true }
]
meta: { calibration_anchor: "2026-03-20", sampling_override: "tenant:high" }
```
Arjun Venkataraman: compact request header idea: `qh:grp=attn|op=attn.proj:oq=fp8` keep it linear. runtime can ignore header unless override present.
Priya Desai: rollout plan sketch: 1) offline anchor evals + linting. 2) internal shadow apply (0.2% traffic), check anchor diffs. 3) canary 5% with sampling_override=high, enable auto-fallback only after second gate. 4) stagger by tenant tiers.
Maria Chen: gating thresholds: anchor-diff < 0.3% tokens changed, human-eval score drop < 0.5 points on calibrated set, and latency delta < 1.5ms. failing any blocks promotion.
Arjun Venkataraman: runtime feature flags needed: profile_expansion (off/on), header_override(enabled/disabled), auto_revert_threshold_ms.
Priya Desai: ops lint: prevent group fallback lists that are superset-of-worse (e.g., fallback[4bit,int8] where int8 consistently better). also warn if group overrides create cycles.
Maria Chen: ops-bot: create checklist ML-4299 for operator-hierarchy quant rollout?
ops-bot: Created ML-4299: "Operator-hierarchy quant rollout checklist" assigned to Maria Chen, Arjun Venkataraman, Priya Desai. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-4299 :white_check_mark:
Arjun Venkataraman: action items: runtime: profile expansion + bitflag table (Arjun). telemetry: sampling config + group counters (Arjun). ML: anchor set + lint + eval harness (Priya). product: tenant tiering plan (Maria).
Priya Desai: timeline?
Maria Chen: target internal shadow next 10 days, 5% canary in 4 weeks if anchors look good.
Arjun Venkataraman: I'll prototype the bitflag table today.
Priya Desai: I'll start picking anchor prompts and build the lint rules.
Maria Chen: thanks all. tagging followup in ML-4299 and we'll do a quick sync after prototypes. :rocket:
